import com.fasterxml.jackson.module.kotlin.jacksonObjectMapper

fun main() {
    val mapper = jacksonObjectMapper()
    val config = mapper.readValue("{\"language\":\"toml\"}", ProcessConfig::class.java)
    val result = TreeSitterLanguagePack.process("key = \"value\"", config)
    println(result)
}
